# Pull Request

## Description
Brief description of what this PR does.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Container/Infrastructure changes

## Testing
- [ ] I have tested this change locally
- [ ] I have tested the Docker container builds successfully
- [ ] I have tested basic container functionality (startup, shell access)

## Container-Specific Checklist
- [ ] Docker image builds on both amd64 and arm64
- [ ] Container starts without critical errors
- [ ] ERPNext is accessible after setup
- [ ] Shell access works correctly
- [ ] No regressions in existing functionality

## Additional Notes
Any additional context or notes for reviewers.
